root_cause.text: The stmmac XDP TX path (stmmac_xdp_xmit_back) unconditionally treated all xdp_frames as page pool-backed (MEM_TYPE_PAGE_POOL) without checking the memory type, causing incorrect DMA operations and a crash when handling zero-copy XSK buffers (MEM_TYPE_PAGE_ORDER0).
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explains that xdp_convert_buff_to_frame() produces different memory types depending on the buffer source, and that “stmmac_xdp_xmit_back() does not check the memory type and always uses the page pool type, this leads to invalid mappings and causes the crash.” The patch adds a check for `xdp->rxq->mem.type == MEM_TYPE_XSK_BUFF_POOL` and passes the result to `stmmac_xdp_xmit_xdpf()` as the `zc` parameter.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE description explains that xdp_convert_buff_to_frame() produces different memory types depending on the buffer source, and that “stmmac_xdp_xmit_back() does not check the memory type and always uses the page pool type, this leads to invalid mappings and causes the crash.” The patch adds a check for `xdp->rxq->mem.type == MEM_TYPE_XSK_BUFF_POOL` and passes the result to `stmmac_xdp_xmit_xdpf()` as the `zc` parameter.
